ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: FAIL. participant-instructions.md contradicts itself on this route's own elections. Lines 75 and 120 are route-specific and right: on K.S.A. 21-6614(b) the one-year box at 8.A.i is 'the only one of the four you will ever mark' and the packet 'has declared the three, five and ten year boxes outside this route' (the registry's waitingPeriods: 1 year under (b)(1); the field map refuses Check Box5/6/7 as NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE). Three other sentences, copied verbatim from the ks-21-6614-conviction-set and ks-21-6614-diversion-set instructions (where they are correct), say the opposite. Line 190, step 3 of 'What you do, in order': '3. Read pages 4, 5 and 6 of the petition. Page 4 lists the convictions that can never be expunged. Pages 5 and 6 are the Judicial Council chart of waiting periods. Decide from the chart which of the year boxes at item 8.A.i is yours, and mark it.' Line 201, 'Things the platform deliberately left blank': 'Every box at item 8.A.i of the petition. Which waiting period applies is a classification of your offence, and the committed record says LegalEase does not classify the offence into a grid severity level.' Line 202: 'The coercion box at item 8.A.iii. That is a sworn assertion about what happened to you, on a different statutory route, and no packet may make it on your behalf.' On this route the coercion box is not on a different statutory route; it is this route's own ground, which the same document says at line 71 ('it is the whole of what makes this shorter route available'). A participant who follows step 3 is told to choose among year boxes the packet elsewhere declares outside the route, on a sworn petition. Per DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A4 an internal contradiction fails under the obligation that carries the false sentence; these sentences are about the route's elections. The PDF's own guidance pages (18-20) do not carry them. The marks themselves are right: Check Box3 (Option A) is the one mark made, measured by ink inside its widget rectangle on packet page 3 of both fixtures (224 dark pixels at 300 dpi inside a 2.5 pt inset), while Check Box1/2 (conviction/diversion), Check Box4 (one year) and the 8.A.iii coercion box read 0 interior ink in both fixtures. requiredOptionsMissing=0 from the verifier; this FAIL is a reading of the participant-facing text, which that counter does not measure.
